Method of Attack: Encrypt targets' enterprise systems and demand ransom payments
Social engineering tactics including callback phishing attacks pretending to be software providers and food delivery services
Use of hacked Twitter accounts to leak victim data and pressure victims
Deployment of encryptors targeting Linux devices, specifically VMware ESXi virtual machines
Discoverer: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
Impacted Systems: U.S. critical infrastructure sectors including healthcare, communications, education
Indicators of Compromise: Indicators of compromise shared by FBI and CISA
Attack Vector: Use of remote access software installed via social engineering
